items.title: Google Warns 2.5B Gmail Users to Reset Passwords Following Salesforce Data Breach
items.description: Google has issued a broad security alert to its 2.5 billion Gmail users, advising them to enhance their account security in the wake of a data breach involving one of the company’s third-party Salesforce systems. items.title: WhatsApp Issues Emergency Update for Zero-Click Exploit Targeting iOS and macOS Devices
items.description: WhatsApp has addressed a security vulnerability in its messaging apps for Apple iOS and macOS that it said may have been exploited in the wild in conjunction with a recently disclosed Apple flaw in targeted zero-day attacks. items.title: U.S. Government Seizes Online Marketplaces Used to Sell Fraudulent Identity Documents to Cybercriminals
items.description: The U.S. Attorney’s Office for the District of New Mexico announced Thursday that federal authorities have executed a court-authorized seizure of two domain names and one affiliated blog associated with VerifTools, an online marketplace peddling counterfeit driver’s licenses, passports, and other state- and country-issued identity documents.
